If ball doesn't come together, add more water, 1 tbsp. at a time, until it does (it should feel a little dry)."}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Turn dough out onto a work surface and knead it until fairly smooth and no longer sticky, about 2 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Set a pasta machine to the widest setting. Cut dough into thirds. Working with 1 dough piece at a time (keep others covered with a dampened kitchen towel), pat into a 1/2-in.-thick oval and feed through machine.'}

{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Fold dough into thirds crosswise and feed through again, starting with an unfolded edge. Fold and feed once more the same way. Sprinkle dough with flour if it feels sticky. Repeat folding and feeding, progressing through 2 or 3 successively narrower settings and rolling dough at least twice on each setting, until dough is as thin as you like (fettuccine is usually 1/16-inch thick). If dough sheet gets too long, cut it in half and roll each half separately.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Repeat with remaining 2 dough pieces, setting sheets to the side when done and covering with a kitchen towel (dampened if the weather is dry).'}

{'step_number': 7, 'text': "Cut each sheet to about 12 in. long and cover with the towel. Pass each dough sheet, dusted with flour if needed to keep from sticking, through the machine's fettuccine cutter. Lay fettuccine on a baking pan and dust with flour. If it's humid outside, let dry for about 1/2 hour to help keep it from sticking as it cooks."}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'To cook, bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. Add fettuccine and cook until barely tender, about 2 to 3 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 9, 'text': 'Make ahead: Through step 7, up to 2 days, wrapped airtight and chilled; up to 2 months, frozen.'}

dishes.name: Moroccan Pan De Casa
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Dissolve the yeast and sugar in water in a large bowl.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Using a dough hook, stir the flour, salt, anise seeds, and sesame seeds into the yeast mixture and knead until smooth.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Place dough in a greased bowl and let rise, covered, for an hour and a half.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Turn the dough out and knead again. Grease two cookie sheets. Divide the dough into 3 rounds and let rise, covered, for another half hour on cookie sheets.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Preheat the oven to 375 degrees. If you want to make this the old-fashioned way, take uneven stones and heat them in the oven on cookie sheets.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Bake the rounds in the oven for 30 minutes or until the rounds sound hollow when tapped. If using stones, brush them with oil first, then place the rounds on top.'}

dishes.name: Arabic Lentil Soup - Shorbat Addas
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'In a large pot or pressure cooker, saute chopped onions in vegetable oil until soft.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Rinse dried lentils several times.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add lentils, water, salt and pepper to the pot.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Bring to boil and simmer for an hour or more until lentils turn yellow in color and are soft and dissolving in broth.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'If using a pressure cooker, cook for 15 minutes after pressure has risen. Release pressure before removing lid.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Whisk lentils to make a smooth soup, or stir to blend for a more textured soup.'}

dishes.name: Lebanese Lentils (Mujadara)
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Heat oil in pan.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'add onions, and cook on medium high heat until they are brown- stir occasionally.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'stir in rice and lentils, mix in with onions.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'add water.'}

{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'This will take over an hour. The water will be absorbed into rice and lentils. Make sure they are soft. Sometimes you may need to add a little more water. Stir occasionally.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'Best if served in a shallow bowl, and let sit for 10 minutes or so. Enjoy warm or cold.'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Gradually add the remaining flour.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Let the mixture cool for about 20 minutes and then add the egg beaten, mix well. Form patties the size of the palm of your hand. On a heated skillet with just a drop of olive oil brown them on both sides and that is it. Ouila!'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Set a pasta machine to the widest setting. Cut dough into thirds. Working with 1 dough piece at a time (keep others covered with a dampened kitchen towel), pat into a 1/2-in.-thick oval and feed through machine.'}

{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Fold dough into thirds crosswise and feed through again, starting with an unfolded edge. Fold and feed once more the same way. {'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat liquids until very warm (120° to 130°).'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add to dry mixture; beat well.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Stir in enough more flour to make a stiff batter.'}

dishes.name: Homemade Roman-Style Pizza Pockets (
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Combine flour, salt, and yeast in large bowl and whisk together until homogenous. Add water and stir with wooden spoon until no dry flour remains, about 2 minutes. Add 40g (1.4 ounces; 3 tablespoons) olive oil and stir to incorporate, using hands if necessary to work oil into dough. Transfer dough to a clean large bowl that has been lightly greased with olive oil; cover with plastic wrap, and let rest at room temperature for 1 hour.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Transfer dough to clean surface dusted with flour; dust your hands and dough with flour. Pat dough into large rectangle, with long sides of the rectangle parallel to countertop. Gently pull the upper long edge of the rectangle, stretching dough, and fold it into the middle of the rectangle. Then gently pull the lower edge, and fold it into the middle of the rectangle. Pinch these folded edges together to seal them together, forming a seam. Rotate dough 90 degrees, and repeat folding and sealing process. Rotate dough 90 degrees and repeat once more. Cover dough with a clean kitchen towel and let rest for 15 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Repeat this entire folding process once more, for a total of 6 folds. Place dough seam side down in lightly greased large bowl. Lightly drizzle dough with olive oil, and use your hands to gently rub it over the surface. Cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 18 hours or up to 3 days.'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': "Remove dough from refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 10 minutes. Lightly spray 13-by-18-inch rimmed baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray; pour remaining 40g (1.4 ounces; 3 tablespoons) olive oil onto baking sheet and spread over entire inner surface (including rim) with your hands. Transfer dough seam side down to prepared baking sheet, and spread gently with your hands to mostly fill the pan (don't worry if dough doesn't fully stretch to edges). Lightly dust surface of dough with flour, cover with clean kitchen towel, and let rise at room temperature until dough is very soft and puffy and nearly doubled in volume, 1 1/2 to 2 hours."}

{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'One hour before baking, adjust oven rack to lower-middle position. Place baking stone or Baking Steel on it , and preheat oven to 550°F (290°C). Using floured hands, gently push and stretch dough into corners of the pan by pressing out from the center. Divide dough into 8 equal-sized rectangles by first drizzling olive oil to trace outline of pieces, and then use bench scraper to cut dough along the lines. Drizzle more olive oil over top of the dough, and use hands to gently rub over entire surface. Sprinkle with coarse sea salt. Transfer entire baking sheet with dough to oven, positioning it on top of baking stone.'}

{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Bake until dough is cooked through and top surface of pizza is burnished golden brown, about 16 minutes, rotating baking sheet halfway through baking. Let pizza cool in baking sheet on wire rack for 5 minutes; use spatula to separate pieces. When ready to serve, return pizza pieces to oven to bake directly on baking stone until bottom crust is evenly browned and crisp, about 4 minutes. Transfer to cutting board; cut each piece in half diagonally, and then cut slit down middle of the now-exposed interior of each pizza triangle to form a pizza pocket. Stuff pockets with fillings of your choice, and serve immediately.'}

dishes.name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Cook rice, chill.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat 1/2 of oil, add eggs and scramble slightly. Remove from heat.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add rest of oil, fry onions and chicken. Add rice, stir to coat.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Stir in eggs and remaining ingredients. Heat through.'}

dishes.name: Sunset Magazine’S Irish Oatmeal Bread
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Combine the first 5 ingredients in the bowl of a stand-up mixer, and let stand 25 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Dissolve granulated sugar and yeast in warm water; let stand 5 minutes or until foamy. Add to oat mixture. Lightly spoon flours into dry measuring cups; level with a knife. Gradually add flour to oat mixture. Beat at medium speed until well blended.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Turn dough out onto a floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic (about 8 minutes); add enough of the flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, to prevent dough from sticking to hands (dough will feel sticky).'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Place dough in a large bowl coated with cooking spray, turning to coat top. Cover and let rise in a warm place (85°), free from drafts, 1 hour or until doubled in size. (Gently press two fingers into dough. If indentation remains, dough has risen enough.) Punch dough down; cover and let rest 5 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Divide in half. Working with one portion at a time (cover remaining dough to prevent drying), roll each portion into a 14 x 8-inch rectangle on a floured surface. Roll up each rectangle tightly, starting with a short edge, pressing firmly to eliminate air pockets; pinch seam and ends to seal. Place each loaf, seam sides down, in a 9-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray. Cover and let rise 30 minutes or until doubled in size.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Preheat oven to 350°. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until loaves are browned on bottom and sound hollow when tapped. Remove from pan, and cool on wire racks.'}

dishes.name: Lentil Curry
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Rinse lentils and place in a heavy pot; cover with water and bring to boil. Reduce heat to low, cover and cook for 30 min until tender.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in cumin, chili flakes and tumeric and cook for about 1 minute or until you can smell the spices.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add lentils to skillet and cook over medium-low heat for 15-17 minutes or until lentils are thickened.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with cilantro and mint.'}

dishes.name: Dal Bhat (Red Lentils With Rice)
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Wash the lentils and rinse a couple of times. Be careful to remove any stones. If you have time, soak the lentils in water as long as you can, up to overnight, before you cook. They get very soft and cook faster.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Start rice preparation according to package directions.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Prep the onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, and cilantro/green onion and set aside.'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Heat oil on high. Add ginger, garlic and onion, and stir fry on high until the onion is a little brown on the edges, 1-2 minutes. Stir in cumin seeds, salt , turmeric, mustard seed and coriander powder. Turn the heat down to medium and cook for 2 minutes, stirring often. Add tomatoes and butter. Stir, cover with lid and cook for 4 minutes. Stir in the lentils, cover and cook for 5 minutes. After cooking for 5 minutes, add one cup of water, cover with lid and cook for 5 more minutes. When the 5 minutes are up, stir in 2 more cups of water, as the water will begin to decrease as you cook. Continue cooking on medium for 10 minutes. The dal should be cooked and ready to serve. If not tender, cook a little longer, adding more water if necessary.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Sprinkle the chopped cilantro and/or green onion on top of the dal and serve with or on top of the rice. It is typical to serve with chutney or spicy peppers.'}

steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'In a large bowl, mix together flours, salt, cayenne, and black pepper.'}

If ball doesn't come together, add more water, 1 tbsp. at a time, until it does (it should feel a little dry)."}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Turn dough out onto a work surface and knead it until fairly smooth and no longer sticky, about 2 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Set a pasta machine to the widest setting. Cut dough into thirds. Working with 1 dough piece at a time (keep others covered with a dampened kitchen towel), pat into a 1/2-in.-thick oval and feed through machine.'}

If dough sheet gets too long, cut it in half and roll each half separately.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Repeat with remaining 2 dough pieces, setting sheets to the side when done and covering with a kitchen towel (dampened if the weather is dry).'}

{'step_number': 7, 'text': "Cut each sheet to about 12 in. long and cover with the towel. Pass each dough sheet, dusted with flour if needed to keep from sticking, through the machine's fettuccine cutter. Lay fettuccine on a baking pan and dust with flour. If it's humid outside, let dry for about 1/2 hour to help keep it from sticking as it cooks."}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'To cook, bring a large pot of well-salted water to a boil. Add fettuccine and cook until barely tender, about 2 to 3 minutes.'}

dishes.name: Homemade Roman-Style Pizza Pockets (
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Combine flour, salt, and yeast in large bowl and whisk together until homogenous. Add water and stir with wooden spoon until no dry flour remains, about 2 minutes. Add 40g (1.4 ounces; 3 tablespoons) olive oil and stir to incorporate, using hands if necessary to work oil into dough. Transfer dough to a clean large bowl that has been lightly greased with olive oil; cover with plastic wrap, and let rest at room temperature for 1 hour.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Transfer dough to clean surface dusted with flour; dust your hands and dough with flour. Pat dough into large rectangle, with long sides of the rectangle parallel to countertop. Gently pull the upper long edge of the rectangle, stretching dough, and fold it into the middle of the rectangle. Then gently pull the lower edge, and fold it into the middle of the rectangle. Pinch these folded edges together to seal them together, forming a seam. Rotate dough 90 degrees, and repeat folding and sealing process. Rotate dough 90 degrees and repeat once more. Cover dough with a clean kitchen towel and let rest for 15 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Repeat this entire folding process once more, for a total of 6 folds. Place dough seam side down in lightly greased large bowl. Lightly drizzle dough with olive oil, and use your hands to gently rub it over the surface. Cover tightly with plastic wrap, and refrigerate for at least 18 hours or up to 3 days.'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': "Remove dough from refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 10 minutes. Lightly spray 13-by-18-inch rimmed baking sheet with vegetable cooking spray; pour remaining 40g (1.4 ounces; 3 tablespoons) olive oil onto baking sheet and spread over entire inner surface (including rim) with your hands. Transfer dough seam side down to prepared baking sheet, and spread gently with your hands to mostly fill the pan (don't worry if dough doesn't fully stretch to edges). Lightly dust surface of dough with flour, cover with clean kitchen towel, and let rise at room temperature until dough is very soft and puffy and nearly doubled in volume, 1 1/2 to 2 hours."}

{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'One hour before baking, adjust oven rack to lower-middle position. Place baking stone or Baking Steel on it , and preheat oven to 550°F (290°C). Using floured hands, gently push and stretch dough into corners of the pan by pressing out from the center. Divide dough into 8 equal-sized rectangles by first drizzling olive oil to trace outline of pieces, and then use bench scraper to cut dough along the lines. Drizzle more olive oil over top of the dough, and use hands to gently rub over entire surface. Sprinkle with coarse sea salt. Transfer entire baking sheet with dough to oven, positioning it on top of baking stone.'}

{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Bake until dough is cooked through and top surface of pizza is burnished golden brown, about 16 minutes, rotating baking sheet halfway through baking. Let pizza cool in baking sheet on wire rack for 5 minutes; use spatula to separate pieces. When ready to serve, return pizza pieces to oven to bake directly on baking stone until bottom crust is evenly browned and crisp, about 4 minutes. Transfer to cutting board; cut each piece in half diagonally, and then cut slit down middle of the now-exposed interior of each pizza triangle to form a pizza pocket. Stuff pockets with fillings of your choice, and serve immediately.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Stir in cumin, chili flakes and tumeric and cook for about 1 minute or until you can smell the spices.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add lentils to skillet and cook over medium-low heat for 15-17 minutes or until lentils are thickened.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with cilantro and mint.'}

dishes.name: Stir Fried Bok Choy
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Toast sesame seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat until light browned, approximately 2-3 minutes. Toss or stir frequently to keep from burning. Remove and place in a small bowl.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat canola oil in the same skillet over medium high heat. Add ginger, onion and bok choy. Cook for 2-3 minutes, stirring frequently. Add garlic, red pepper and soy sauce and cook for additional 1 minute. Sprinkle with toasted sesame seeds and serve immediately.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Note: Remove the bottom 2 inches of the thick bulb of bok choy. Chop bok choy and rinse thoroughly in a colander. Shake as much of the water out as possible. Dry excess water with a paper towel.'}

dishes.name: Sunset Magazine’S Irish Oatmeal Bread
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Combine the first 5 ingredients in the bowl of a stand-up mixer, and let stand 25 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Dissolve granulated sugar and yeast in warm water; let stand 5 minutes or until foamy. Add to oat mixture. Lightly spoon flours into dry measuring cups; level with a knife. Gradually add flour to oat mixture. Beat at medium speed until well blended.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Turn dough out onto a floured surface. Knead until smooth and elastic (about 8 minutes); add enough of the flour, 1 tablespoon at a time, to prevent dough from sticking to hands (dough will feel sticky).'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Place dough in a large bowl coated with cooking spray, turning to coat top. Cover and let rise in a warm place (85°), free from drafts, 1 hour or until doubled in size. (Gently press two fingers into dough. If indentation remains, dough has risen enough.) Punch dough down; cover and let rest 5 minutes.'}

{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Divide in half. Working with one portion at a time (cover remaining dough to prevent drying), roll each portion into a 14 x 8-inch rectangle on a floured surface. Roll up each rectangle tightly, starting with a short edge, pressing firmly to eliminate air pockets; pinch seam and ends to seal. Place each loaf, seam sides down, in a 9-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray. Cover and let rise 30 minutes or until doubled in size.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Preheat oven to 350°. Bake at 350° for 45 minutes or until loaves are browned on bottom and sound hollow when tapped. Remove from pan, and cool on wire racks.'}

dishes.name: Dal Bhat (Red Lentils With Rice)
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Wash the lentils and rinse a couple of times. Be careful to remove any stones. If you have time, soak the lentils in water as long as you can, up to overnight, before you cook. They get very soft and cook faster.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Start rice preparation according to package directions.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Prep the onion, garlic, ginger, tomatoes, and cilantro/green onion and set aside.'}

{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Heat oil on high. Add ginger, garlic and onion, and stir fry on high until the onion is a little brown on the edges, 1-2 minutes. Stir in cumin seeds, salt , turmeric, mustard seed and coriander powder. Turn the heat down to medium and cook for 2 minutes, stirring often. Add tomatoes and butter. Stir, cover with lid and cook for 4 minutes. Stir in the lentils, cover and cook for 5 minutes. After cooking for 5 minutes, add one cup of water, cover with lid and cook for 5 more minutes. When the 5 minutes are up, stir in 2 more cups of water, as the water will begin to decrease as you cook. Continue cooking on medium for 10 minutes. The dal should be cooked and ready to serve. If not tender, cook a little longer, adding more water if necessary.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Sprinkle the chopped cilantro and/or green onion on top of the dal and serve with or on top of the rice. It is typical to serve with chutney or spicy peppers.'}

dishes.name: Easy Glazed Carrots
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Steam carrots for 10 to 15 minutes over boiling water.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'In a mixing bowl, combine drained carrots with butter, marmalade and pecans. Serve while hot. Yield: 4 servings.'}

dishes.name: Pizza Dough
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Dissolve yeast in warm milk.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Add salt and flour; knead.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add 1/2 cup flour or more until dough is not sticky.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Let rise half hour.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Press on cookie sheet.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Add toppings.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Bake at 400° for 30 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'Serves 4 to 6.'}

dishes.name: Orange-Glazed Carrots
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Cook carrots in slightly salted water until tender; drain. Combine sugar, starch, salt and ginger in saucepan.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Add orange juice.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Cook and stir until thick and bubbly.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes longer.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Stir in margarine, pour over hot carrots, stirring lightly to coat.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Makes 4 to 6 servings.'}

dishes.name: Crusty Cuban Bread
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Proof yeast with warm water sugar and salt for about 5-10 min. Add to flour and kneed with bread hook. Cover with damp towel and let rise until it doubles. Punch down and form into a loaf on a baking sheet lightly greased and sprinkled with cornmeal. Bake for 30-40 min. on 350 degrees.'}

dishes.name: Russian Ploff
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'steam meat (anykind) until almost done, throw in onions and carrots, steam until tender, pour in rice on the meat and pour water over it so that it covers the rice and meat about 1 to 2 cm.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'bring to boil and turn on low temperature, let cook for about 30 minutes.'}

dishes.name: Sauerkraut Salad
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Bring the sugar and vinegar to a boil; cook until sugar is dissolved.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Cool and mix all ingredients together.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Put in a quart jar and let marinate all night in the refrigerator.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Turn jar each day to mix.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'This will keep for several weeks.'}

dishes.name: Tofu Alla Debbie
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Cut the block of tofu into 1-inch cubes.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'In a skillet, heat peanut oil. Stir fry tofu on one side, add salt, then flip on the other side; add salt and cook until golden brown.'}

{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'In a bowl whisk corn starch and cold water. Add sesame oil and soy sauce. Add it to the tofu, stir, cover with a lid and let cook for a few seconds or until dense. Add the beaten egg, stir around. Last, add some green onions.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Serve on a bed of warm rice.'}

dishes.name: Greek Carrots
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Place carrots in saucepan along with remaining ingredients. Cover.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Bring to a boil.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Simmer for 5 minutes.'}

dishes.name: Home-made Mandazi
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'This is one recipe a lot of people have requested and I have tried to make it as simple as possible and I hope it will work for you. Make sure you use the right flour which is basically one with raising agents. Adjust the amount of sugar to your taste and try using different flavours to have variety whenever you have them.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'You can use Coconut milk instead of regular milk, you can also add desiccated coconut to the dry flour or other spices like powdered cloves or cinnamon.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'For “healthy looking” mandazis do not roll the dough too thin before frying and use the procedure I have indicated above.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': '1. Mix the flour,cinnamon and sugar in a suitable bowl.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': '2. In a separate bowl whisk the egg into the milk'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': '3. Make a well at the centre of the flour and add the milk and egg mixture and slowly mix to form a dough.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': '4. Knead the dough for 3-4 minutes or until it stops sticking to the sides of the bowl and you have a smooth surface.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': '5. Cover the dough with a damp cloth  and allow to rest for 15 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 9, 'text': '6. Roll the dough on a lightly floured surface into a 1cm thick piece.'}
{'step_number': 10, 'text': '7. Using a sharp small knife, cut the dough into the desired size setting aside ready for deep frying.'}
{'step_number': 11, 'text': '8. Heat your oil in a suitable pot and gently dip the mandazi pieces to cook until light brown on the first side then turn to cook on the second side.'}
{'step_number': 12, 'text': '9. Serve them warm or cold'}

dishes.name: Pelmeni
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Mix ground chicken, onion, salt, and pepper together in a bowl.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Sift all-purpose flour and 1/2 cup whole wheat flour together in a bowl. Add 1/2 teaspoon salt.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Whisk milk and egg together in a small bowl. Pour over flour mixture; mix until dough comes together.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Turn dough out on a lightly floured work surface. Knead, adding the remaining 1/2 cup whole wheat flour, until dough is elastic. Divide dough into 4 pieces.'}

{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Roll out 1 piece dough to 1/16-inch thickness. Cut into circles with a 2-inch cookie cutter or water glass. Place 1 teaspoon chicken mixture in the center. Brush edges with water. Fold over into a half-moon shape and seal edges. Repeat with remaining dough and chicken mixture.'}

{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Fill a large pot with water; add remaining 1/2 teaspoon salt and bay leaf. Bring to a boil. Cook pelmeni in batches until they float to the top, about 5 minutes per batch. Transfer to a platter using a slotted spoon.'}

dishes.name: Spicy Sweet And Sour Cabbage
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Combine sugar, salt, soy sauce and vinegar; set aside.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat oil in large skillet; add red peppers and cook 5 seconds.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Add cabbage; cook 5 minutes, stirring frequently.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Stir soy mixture and pour over cabbage.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Turn heat to high.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Stir until well mixed. Serve immediately.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Yields 6 servings.'}

dishes.name: Italian Gnocchi
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Boil potatoes with jackets on until fork-tender.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Drain.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': "Peel and rice them (mash them if you don't have a ricer)."}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Gradually add the remaining ingredients and knead until smooth and manageable.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Roll dough into long rope-like strips about 3/4-inch pieces.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Dip your fingers in flour and dent each piece.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Boil 8 quarts water rapidly adding 2 tablespoons salt.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'Boil 10 minutes and drain.'}
{'step_number': 9, 'text': 'Add favorite sauce.'}
{'step_number': 10, 'text': 'Serves 6 to 8.'}

dishes.name: Vidalia Onions
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Peel large onions.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Place in individual ramekins.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Salt and pepper to taste.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Top each with a small pat of margarine. Microwave on High 3 to 4 minutes per onion or until tender. Serves 4.'}

dishes.name: French Baguettes
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'In a small bowl dissolve yeast in 1/2 cup warm water.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Stir with a fork.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Set aside for 10 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Combine the flour and salt.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Add the yeast mixture, and stir in the remaining 1 1/2 cups water.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Mix the dough until it is sticky enough to knead.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'On a lightly floured board, knead for 6 to 10 minutes; the dough should be sticky and smooth.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'Put the dough in a bowl, cover with a damp tea towel, and let rise at room temperature until doubled in volume, about 1 hour.'}
{'step_number': 9, 'text': 'Punch down the dough and divide into 4 pieces.'}
{'step_number': 10, 'text': 'Roll each into a ball and shape into a baguette.'}
{'step_number': 11, 'text': 'Transfer the loaves to a lightly greased baking sheet or baguette pan and let rise until nearly doubled.'}
{'step_number': 12, 'text': '(I use 2 baking sheets, with 3 smaller loaves per sheet).'}
{'step_number': 13, 'text': 'Preheat the oven to 450 degrees.'}
{'step_number': 14, 'text': 'Brush the baguettes with the egg-water mixture.'}
{'step_number': 15, 'text': 'Score the loaves diagonally across the top with a sharp knife.'}
{'step_number': 16, 'text': 'Pour 2 cups of hot water into a pan and place in the preheated oven next to the baguettes to provide moisture.'}
{'step_number': 17, 'text': 'Bake the baguettes for 15 minutes, and then lower the temperature to 400 degrees and bake for 5 to 10 minutes more, until golden brown.'}
{'step_number': 18, 'text': 'Remove from the oven and cool on a rack before slicing.'}
{'step_number': 19, 'text': 'Occasionally I burn the bottom of the bread, in which case I scrape it off with a sharp serrated knife and it remains my secret!'}

dishes.name: Chicken Steak(Chinese)
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Wash, then dry chicken legs with paper towels.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Cut the chicken legs at the joint to yield 8 pieces.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Debone and discard the skins.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Marinate chicken pieces in a bowl with cornstarch, soy sauce, sherry, salt, sugar and garlic.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Set aside for 30 minutes or overnight.'}

dishes.name: Russian-Korean Carrot Salad
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Mix together sugar, salt, ground coriander, black pepper, garlic, chili powder, and white vinegar. Pour the mixture over the carrots and mix well.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Heat oil in a saucepan until hot; pour over carrots and mix thoroughly.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Allow to marinate in the fridge at least overnight.'}

dishes.name: Sunshine Chicken
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Season chicken with curry powder, salt and pepper.'}
{'step_number': 2, 'text': 'Brown in oil until golden.'}
{'step_number': 3, 'text': 'Combine orange juice, water, brown sugar, dry mustard and mix well.'}
{'step_number': 4, 'text': 'Add to chicken; simmer covered for 20 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 5, 'text': 'Lift chicken from broth and add rice.'}
{'step_number': 6, 'text': 'Arrange chicken pieces over rice.'}
{'step_number': 7, 'text': 'Bring to a boil.'}
{'step_number': 8, 'text': 'Cover and simmer 20 minutes longer.'}
{'step_number': 9, 'text': 'Remove from heat and let stand covered until liquid is absorbed, about 5 minutes.'}
{'step_number': 10, 'text': 'Sprinkle with parsley.'}
{'step_number': 11, 'text': 'Makes 6 servings.'}

dishes.name: Chinese Carrots
steps: {'step_number': 1, 'text': 'Shred carrots coarsely. Melt butter in skillet and add carrots. Sprinkle with salt and sugar. Cover and cook for 8 to 10 minutes. Top with parsley. Serves 6.'}
